g.text: BEAM transfer: all matched engine gains, ties and regressions
Reference: custom body BM25 at the same question, packer and budget. Each cell has 264 measured valid pairs; 270 nominal pairs include six unscorable labels.
Ties combine joint full-message recoveries and joint nonrecoveries. The body reference is shown as 264 structural ties.
Repeated synthetic histories/questions; descriptive changes only, no population winner, significance test or confidence interval. Independent actual execution audit accepted.
